issue: specs/behavioral-spec.md C1 'FALLBACKS' (a MUST per this project's own no-optional-spec rule, CLAUDE.md 0.7) requires: 'STT — Groq Whisper → faster-whisper (local, $0) → Deepgram; LLM — Groq Llama → Gemini Flash text (cheap) / DeepSeek; TTS — edge-tts → local Kokoro/piper. The fail-closed trigger covers ALL of: GROQ_API_KEY absent/unauthorized (401/403), Groq 429 rate-limit ..., and timeout → switch that leg to its fallback for the turn. ... Never a silent call (no audio producible → log + graceful hang-up, not silence).' None of these local/alternate fallback providers are actually wired: (1) server.js:358-362 closes the websocket immediately and unconditionally if `GROQ_API_KEY` is empty — the ENTIRE call is refused before any audio, local fallback, or graceful spoken message is produced (the caller just gets a dropped/silent connection); (2) the `stt` adapter (server.js:401-405) on a Groq error just returns `""` (no transcript, no faster-whisper attempt, no response for that turn); (3) the `llm` adapter (server.js:406-409) on a Groq error does not call Gemini-Flash-text or DeepSeek — it substitutes a single hardcoded apology string as if it were the model's own output; (4) the `tts` adapter (server.js:410) on an edge-tts error returns `null` with no Kokoro/piper fallback, so `if (audio) await send(audio)` in compositional-voice.cjs silently skips that sentence's audio entirely — if EVERY sentence's TTS fails for a turn, the caller hears literal silence with no hang-up, directly violating the 'Never a silent call' invariant. The pure fail-closed SELECTOR functions that were built and unit-tested for exactly this (`chooseSttProvider`→`faster-whisper-local`, `chooseLlmProvider`→`gemini-flash-text` in lib/voice-turn.cjs:78-85) are never imported or called anywhere in server.js or compositional-voice.cjs (grep-confirmed zero production callers) — they are dead code standing in for functionality the spec requires but that isn't actually wired.

evidence.lines: 358-362 (hard close on missing GROQ_KEY, no local fallback attempted), 401-410 (stt/llm/tts adapters degrade to empty-string/canned-line/null instead of calling a real fallback provider)
evidence.corroborating: apps/life-call/lib/voice-turn.cjs:78-85 defines chooseSttProvider/chooseLlmProvider (tested in voice-turn.test.js:39-52) but grep across apps/life-call finds ZERO callers of either function outside its own test file.

fix: Either implement the real fallback legs (a faster-whisper local STT call, a Gemini-Flash-text or DeepSeek chat call, a Kokoro/piper local TTS call) and wire chooseSttProvider/chooseLlmProvider's decisions into the stt/llm/tts adapters in server.js, or narrow the spec's C1 FALLBACKS bullet to what is actually shipped (degrade-to-canned-line / skip-turn) and drop the 'Never a silent call' claim until a real fallback exists. Do not leave chooseSttProvider/chooseLlmProvider as tested-but-unwired dead code implying a guarantee that isn't met.
